### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the one thing": signing the Bluebonnet appeal now leaves its amount unrecordable ("not recorded until ... carries a first-level appeal" — C3260616004 has none) and its contested charges unfixed (CO-31 with no corrected claim). Excluded by visible sentences + records.
- Closest alternatives excluded: older Bluebonnet CO-50 (C3260220561) — not the most recent; appealing the Hill Country CO-16 instead of correcting it — `appeal_filing_rules` 1 "a denial curable by a corrected claim is never appealed"; lab filing the Bluebonnet appeal itself — OON requires patient authorization and the hub makes it the customer's tool; second_level — no prior appeal on the claim; Hill Country as second payer — record and subscriber rule both say primary.
